title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: Look at the 'renovated' column in the DataFrame. Some entries are 'None', which means those rooms have never been renovated.

title: Filtering Non-Renovated Rooms
text: To focus on rooms with renovation data, you need to remove rows where 'renovated' is 'None'.

title: Removing Non-Renovated Rooms
text: Use the DataFrame method to filter out rows where 'renovated' is 'None'.

title: Using the isna() Method
text: The 'isna()' method helps identify 'None' values in a DataFrame. Use it to filter out unwanted rows.
